0.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_OTOPAPOTTOPA_000
0.description: <hex:02084CE3E90C0DFF24020820E3E90C05FF0D476F6F64206576656E696E67FF0C476F6F64206D6F72726F7703FF2102081DE3E90C12FF09476F6F6420646179FF0D476F6F64206576656E696E670303> to you, adventurer. Do you seek lodgings at the Hourglass?

1.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_OTOPAPOTTOPA_001
1.description: Pardon me, what was your name again? <hex:022903EB0203>? Hmmm...I've heard nothing from Mistress Momodi about this. Alas, without her express permission, I cannot permit you to stay.

2.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_Q1_000_1
2.description: What would you like to do?

5.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_OTOPAPOTTOPA_010
5.description: The Hourglass is only the most famous inn on the Merchant Strip.

6.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_OTOPAPOTTOPA_011
6.description: We have accommodations to satisfy every client's tastes, from lavish suites to simple rooms.

7.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_OTOPAPOTTOPA_012
7.description: Were circumstances different, I would gladly invite you to make use of our facilities. However, we have had to enact certain policies in the wake of the Calamity and the unpleasantness that followed. Only those who have proven themselves trustworthy are permitted to stay.

8.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_OTOPAPOTTOPA_013
8.description: Should Mistress Momodi deem you one such individual, you may enjoy our hospitality at will.

10.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_Q2_000_1
10.description: What would you like to do?

16.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_OTOPAPOTTOPA_030
16.description: As you wish, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. Right this way.

17.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_OTOPAPOTTOPA_040
17.description: The key to leading a productive life is to maintain one's health, and to do that you must needs make time to rest and recover.

18.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_OTOPAPOTTOPA_041
18.description: There are few things more rejuvenating than a good night's sleep after a hard day's work.

19.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_SYSTEM_000_13
19.description: Entering an inn room grants a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>resting<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> status. This indicates that you are gradually accumulating a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>rested bonus<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>. Should you log out from inside an inn room, the process will continue while you are offline.

20.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_SYSTEM_000_14
20.description: While a rested bonus is in effect, experience points earned through combat, synthesis, and gathering are increased by 50%.

21.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_SYSTEM_000_15
21.description: When you gain experience, your rested bonus will decrease proportionally.

22.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_SYSTEM_000_16
22.description: Once your accumulated rested bonus disappears completely, the amount of experience you gain will revert to normal.

23.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_OTOPAPOTTOPA_050
23.description: I'm afraid our facilities are intended only for rest and relaxation, so a number of activities are expressly forbidden.

24.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_OTOPAPOTTOPA_051
24.description: Even if you are an acclaimed artisan, we must insist that you refrain from practicing your trade. The sound may disturb our guests who desire to rest.

25.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_SYSTEM_000_18
25.description: Synthesis, repairs, and materia melding cannot be performed inside inn rooms.

26.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_OTOPAPOTTOPA_060
26.description: The Hourglass is only the most famous inn on the Merchant Strip.

27.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_OTOPAPOTTOPA_061
27.description: We have accommodations to satisfy every client's tastes, from lavish suites to simple rooms.

28.name: TEXT_REGWILINN_00061_OTOPAPOTTOPA_062
28.description: Per Mistress Momodi's request, you are free to enjoy our hospitality at will. If you wish to rest, it would be my pleasure to show you to a room.
